verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Asana's API, webhooks, app directory and app-component integrations that let other tools create tasks in Asana or push data via automation, but there is no documented feature for surfacing an engineer's assigned tasks from other PM tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) inside a single unified Asana view. missing for 10: a native cross-tool unified task/assignment view, evidence of aggregating external tool tasks into one dashboard.
